input:
learner text: 他把梨从筐里倒出去，他的帽子也倒下去。
quote: 他把梨从筐里倒出去
part p0: fix [ref p0/k0] 梨从筐里撒出去
part p1: comment [ref p1/note] “把“ is used for initiated actions (“disposal”), here it is not he who threw those pears, but the pears fell themselves. 倒 means “pour” if it is an initiated action, and means “fall” if it is not an initiated action, and followed by 下去/下来。

edits.reason: her fix omits the disposal subject-marker phrase

edits.note: “把“ is used for initiated actions (“disposal”), here it is not he who threw those pears, but the pears fell themselves. 倒 means “pour” if it is an initiated action, and means “fall” if it is not an initiated action, and followed by 下去/下来。
edits.reason: teacher explains why 把 and 倒 are inappropriate here
